a.lede: Bell Canada has confirmed that an "agentic" threat actor breached its systems on November 17, 2026, and stole enterprise customer data, including information from a system used to order and provision telecommunications circuits. [...]
a.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data

b.lede: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is warning that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card information, including credit card numbers and CVV security codes. [...]
b.title: Cleverbridge warns hackers stole credit card numbers, CVVs in data breach
